name: Bounced message
description: Unread mail past its age (24 h session, 7 d project, or a session expiring) goes back to its sender. The bounce is written before its done marker and before the original is removed, so a failure leaves it unread and a later pass retries.

meanings.unread: Original still in the inbox, no done marker.
meanings.bounce_written: Bounce XADDed to the sender with msg_id b-<hash>.

transitions.trigger: Mail lands and is not read

transitions.guard: Older than the bounce age, kind is not bounce, no done marker
Next pass writes again with the same msg_id; the sender's reader drops the repeat
Same pass, or a later pass that finds the marker set
